RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Assigning a percentage would imply knowledge we don’t have.

Your credentials justify asking how the decision was reached, but publication counts and PhD completion may not outweigh industry experience, teaching performance, or fit with the advertised criteria.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and any review deadlines. If a completed PhD was mandatory, specifically ask how that requirement was applied.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-related comments or inconsistent treatment—not simply because the panel members were women.
